name: kanban
about: a small web app: a kanban board you can add cards to
prompt: Write a kanban board as one self-contained HTML file: inline CSS and JavaScript, no external files or libraries. Three columns titled To do, Doing and Done. A text box with the placeholder "New card" and an Add button add a card with that text to the To do column. Cards can be dragged between columns. Answer with only the file, in one ```html block.
